headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 25, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Mitch Keller earning the win. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. In other news, the Detroit Tigers took down the Baltimore Orioles 4-1, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense and Drew Anderson earning a save.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Max Kranick being transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Washington Nationals due to right elbow surgery recovery. Dylan Cease has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays with a left hamstring strain. The Colorado Rockies have placed Jose Quintana on the 10-day injured list with a left elbow sprain, while the Cleveland Guardians have placed Erik Sabrowski on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 22, 2026, due to left elbow inflammation.

The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, while the Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley, and the Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Blue Jays 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Mitch Keller earning the win. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Colton Cowser leading the Orioles' offense. Cowser hit a crucial home run, scoring two runs and driving in three.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense and Drew Anderson earning a save.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Red Sox in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins edged out the Boston Red Sox 6-5, securing their win. Willson Contreras led the Twins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cubs in Thrilling 1-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a narrow win over the Chicago Cubs, with a final score of 2-1. Ben Brown was a standout performer for the Pirates, leading the team to victory.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays suffered a 7-9 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, marking their defeat in the matchup. Impact hitters for the game included Chandler Simpson, Jonathan Aranda, Richie Palacios, Victor Mesa Jr., and Jonny DeLuca.

top_news.title: **Nationals' Max Kranick Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals right-hander Max Kranick has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to his ongoing right elbow surgery recovery.

top_news.title: **Rockies Make Roster Move Ahead of Series**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies have traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash.
